name: Phase 90

dims.source: preset mxr_standard 60 x 111 x 32 mm bare enclosure (parts.js PRESETS, high confidence); heights.json MXR | Phase 90 high hand-verified 1.25in overall (Sweetwater M101)

knobs.note: Centered single SPEED control. Photo-derived: top-down mxr-m101.png knob center v~0.18 -> z=(0.18-0.5)*4.37=-1.40. Pointer rot offset to match photo (~1 o'clock).

led.note: Centered red LED below MXR block logo. Photo mxr-m101.png LED v~0.59 -> z=0.39.

footswitch.note: Round chrome stomp switch, centered. Photo v~0.72 -> z=0.96.

jacks.note: INPUT on right wall (player's right when pedal faces forward). Photo jack axis v~0.38.

powerJack.note: 9V recessed round barrel on back wall, right of center. y=1.26-0.474 explicit so assembler and validator agree.

labels.note: Black spaced caps below SPEED knob, matches mxr-m101.png
Vertical INPUT print on top edge by right jack, as in mxr-m101.png
Vertical OUTPUT print on top edge by left jack, as in mxr-m101.png
Block MXR logo centered between SPEED and LED. Real pedal has rounded-rect border; bold block text is first-pass vector (see notes).

notes: MXR Phase 90 (M101) hero, detailed standalone for later board adaptation. Bare-enclosure dims from parts.js PRESETS.mxr_standard (60x111x32mm, high). PedalPlayground footprint 2.67x4.50 includes jack protrusion and is not used for dims. Single SPEED knob + LED + round footswitch; no treadle. Coordinates: back=-z (knob side), front=+z (phase 90 text). All deck parts seat via surfaceAt() (flat deck h=1.26) — no hardcoded y on knobs/LED/switch. MXR badge border and the phase 90 lettering (rounded sans, z=1.72) are baked into textures/mxr-phase90-decal.png so the letterforms render identically on every platform; SPEED/INPUT/OUTPUT/MXR remain vector textLabels.
